title: Trend Micro Mail Encryption Gateway SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Trend Micro Email Encryption Gateway. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the authentication functionality. The issue lies in the failure to sanitize user-supplied input prior to executing a SQL statement. An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication or execute code under the context of the database.
